InnoTransit Mouse Transport Cart

Visual concealment & reduced allergen exposure in a smooth ride

The InnoTransit Cart, developed in collaboration with Plastic Concepts, Inc., is designed to solve these challenges and makes everyday transport easy on in vivo teams, animals, and in general areas.The InnoTransit Cart, developed in collaboration with Plastic Concepts, Inc., is designed to solve these challenges and makes everyday transport easy on in vivo teams, animals, and in general areas. Contact Sales

Product Specifications

Product code IT-InnoTransit CartDimensions 30” W x 31.75” D x 54.13”H Cage Positions30 (15 on each side)Shelving OptionsBack-to-back shelving/bin compartments (3) across x (5) downConstructionWhite and Black Polypropylene ConstructionStructure Solid shelvesAirflow Air flow cutouts on interior dividers Door ConstructionDouble-sided latched doors with 316 stainless steel hinges and gasketFilterationHEPA Inlet/Outlet FiltersMobility Spring-loaded chrome-plated swivel casters with rubber wheels and brakesCleaningPush handles on each end

Customizable Options

  • Plug-In-Fan/Blower with HEPA Ventilation
  • Rechargeable Battery-Powered Fan Blower, available in 2-3 hr, 6-8 hr or 12-14 hr battery life
  • Clear Door (comes standard with opaque doors)

Key Benefits

  • Minimized Vibration & Shock Absorption
  • • Shock-absorbing wheels provide a smooth ride over rough surfaces and stabilize motion across freight elevator gaps.
  • • Lessens water bottle drip during transit.
  • • Reduces animal stress while moving.
  • Reduced Allergen Exposure
  • • Shields animals from airborne contaminants and facility traffic outside the vivarium. Fully enclosed with HEPA-filtered cartridges at top and bottom.
  • • Protects staff in shared corridors from laboratory animal allergen exposure.
  • Visual Concealment and Security
  • • Generic white exterior is indistinguishable from standard facility equipment.
  • • Durable steel hinges on secure latching doors keep cages firmly in place.
  • Durability and Sanitation
  • • Solid polypropylene construction built for daily vivarium use.
  • • Fully sanitizable with approved disinfectants.
